answer: The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in kernel, expire in island, and gale lists each expiry. Someone running 38 aliases thus needs 15 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4159 identities would post 4648 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
